And here are the Steel Teeth that a Dwarven knife sharpener spent weeks making. Ah, and see these new Hatchling items! Look around -- a good pet owner always comes to the Dion Pet…

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-00.htm.text: Pet Manager Waters: Hey, could you do me a favor?

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-00a.html.text: Hmm... Now that I see you in the light... You're not what I'm looking for at all! You look too scruffy and poor! (This quest can be performed only by the characters at the 25th level or above.)

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-02.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Wonderful, you've brought it. Much thanks! So I have this uncle... one day my uncle just up and moves out north. He said he would earn cash as an adventurer. I hear he's actually pretty good, he takes on quests other adventurers couldn't. But he's family, so I'm worried. I wante…

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-02a.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Please bring me a Trident. I really need one.

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-04.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Please destroy the monsterous eye so I can ship the Trident safely.

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-05.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Thank you! I've heard marvelous stories about a great adventurer who defeated the monsters in this area. Well, where is the Map Pieces?

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-07.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Take the Map to Sophya, captain of the Black Lion Mercenaries.

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-08.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: The Black Lion Mercenaries have always been trustworthy, but this time you've outdone yourselves! Thank you so much! I should really do something for you...

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-01.htm.text: Pet Manager Waters: Awesome! Please, bring me a Trident ! I simply must have one! They probably sell them in stores around here, but I don't have enough Adena...

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-03.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: I need to send the Trident, but outlaws have been rampant in this area lately! Please kill 30 Monster Eye Gazers and Destroyers ! Destroy them so I can send the Trident safely. Please, you must help me!

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-03a.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Well, you should have suddenly felt that it is too valuable. Then, that's OK. Please bring me one when you have enough.

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-06.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Hmm... Let's see... I think I can put them together... Voila! Isn't it beautiful? Look! The attack plan is written on it! This is great! Send it to Sophya of the Black Lions.

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-06a.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Where is the Map fragment?

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30828-09.html.text: Pet Manager Waters: Don't be modest, my friend! Please accept this as a token of my esteem! It's quite rare, even among very wealthy! It's a pet exchange ticket . Enjoy your new pet, and raise it well!

petmanager/exchange.htm.text: Pet exchange tickets allow their bearer to purchase pets, such as Kookaburra, Buffaloes or Cougars. Sales of the tickets are strictly limited to members. What kind of ticket would you like?
